summary: Implemented the show_speed feature. In rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gains a show_speed kwarg (default False), a static render_speed(speed) that scales via filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix and returns "it/s" Text, and a render branch for unknown totals using finished_speed or speed. The track() helper gains show_speed=True, passed to TaskProgressColumn. Progress.track declares task_total as Optional[float] and no longer raises for unsized iterables. Tests: removed the two ValueError assertions in test_track and test_progress_track and added test_task_progress_column_speed. CHANGELOG has one Added line. Nothing was committed, and tests, mypy, and black were not run per instructions; changes were verified by reading only.
